verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs explicitly describe AI review suggestions with one-click apply ('Ask for suggested fixes and apply them in one click right from the review page') and AI reviews that 'suggest fixes instantly,' matching the story's core capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the applied fix is an actual committable diff (vs. just a chat suggestion) and no community citation validating the one-click apply UX in practice.
